<thought>The spectrum shows a clear isotopic envelope with peaks spaced ~1.003 Da and intensities decreasing roughly by a factor of ~0.08 each step, which matches the natural 13C/12C distribution for a molecule containing multiple carbons. No 2‑Da spaced patterns (Cl, Br, S) or other distinctive signatures are present, so only carbon can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
